summary.intent: Implement SDK-driven E2E and load test packages for CipherBox as an alternative to the existing Playwright-based tests, covering all major SDK operations without browser automation overhead.
summary.outcome: Created two new workspace packages (`tests/sdk-e2e/` and `tests/load/`) with 10 E2E test suites (83 tests, all passing) and 5 load test scenarios, plus 2 CI workflows. Tests run in ~11 seconds vs Playwright's much slower browser-based equivalent.

repo: setApiClientConfig in @cipherbox/api-client is a module-level singleton — multi-account tests must call setApiClientConfig before each operation when switching between accounts, and later test suites can be affected if a prior suite left the singleton pointing at a different account's token

The API throttler (10 req/sec, 100 req/min) applies to test-login and all endpoints; the test-login endpoint has its own stricter limit (5 per 15 min). Throttle limits must be relaxed (via NODE_ENV=test) for SDK test suites to pass
NODE_ENV in the API is set via apps/api/.env which overrides shell env vars when using `nest start --watch` — must edit the .env file directly to change NODE_ENV for a running dev server
ThrottlerModule.forRoot() in app.module.ts can be made environment-aware by returning different ttl/limit values based on process.env.NODE_ENV
The ClaimInviteDto requires encryptedKey to be at least 258 hex chars (129 bytes) — dummy Uint8Array(64) values are too short and will fail DTO validation with 400
Share API returns encryptedKey as a hex string, but @cipherbox/crypto unwrapKey() expects Uint8Array — hexToBytes() conversion is required between API response and unwrapKey call
CipherBoxClient exposes getFolderTree() as a public method, making (client as any).folderTree casts unnecessary
The existing integration test at packages/sdk/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts lines 24-59 is the canonical pattern for test-login → vault init → CipherBoxClient setup

code.finding: ThrottlerModule.forRoot() was modified to return ttl: 0 / limit: 0 when NODE_ENV=test to bypass rate limiting for test suites
Prototype for the createTestContext() factory: test-login → initializeVault → encryptVaultKeys → POST /vault/init → setApiClientConfig → new CipherBoxClient → registerFolder
setApiClientConfig is a global singleton — calling it switches the token for ALL sdk-core IPNS operations globally, not per-client instance
Event emission test needs explicit setApiClientConfig reset because prior multi-account test suites may have left the singleton pointing at a different account

workflow: Running TypeScript check (tsc --noEmit) against new packages immediately after writing catches unused import errors from noUnusedLocals before running tests
pnpm install at workspace root automatically links workspace packages and updates the lockfile for new packages added to pnpm-workspace.yaml
For cross-package imports in tsconfig, rootDir restrictions prevent importing from sibling packages — the load test tsconfig needed adjustment to allow importing from sdk-e2e

The simplify review pattern (3 parallel agents: reuse, quality, efficiency) effectively caught: duplicated account creation logic, missing abstraction for repeated metrics aggregation blocks, and unnecessary type casts

friction: API throttle limits blocked test runs immediately — required modifying app.module.ts and restarting the API before any meaningful test execution could happen
NODE_ENV=test passed as a shell env var was silently overridden by the value in apps/api/.env, causing the throttle fix to appear not to work for several restart attempts
nest start --watch hot-reloads but doesn't pick up .env changes until a full restart — caused confusion about whether the throttle config change took effect
DTO validation (MinLength 258) on ClaimInviteDto was not obvious from the test plan — required a real ECIES-wrapped key rather than a dummy byte array
Share API returns encryptedKey as hex string but the unwrapKey function takes Uint8Array — type mismatch not caught until runtime since the API client types the field as string
open_items: CI workflow service deduplication into reusable workflows was intentionally skipped — sdk-e2e.yml and load-test.yml share identical service definitions with e2e.yml
Load test scenarios are untested against a live environment — only the sdk-e2e suites were validated locally; load tests require more concurrent capacity to verify
The API throttle change (NODE_ENV=test bypass) was committed to the feature branch — needs review to ensure it doesn't accidentally ship to production or affect other test environments
binState has no public getter on CipherBoxClient — bin-operations tests still use (client as any).binState for post-operation state verification; could add a public getBinState() if desired
Concurrent-operations and ipns-consistency test suites were written but not explicitly validated in the local run output — the 83-test count suggests they passed but worth confirming suite-by-suite
